title.narrative: Grant to World Resources Institute for creation of degraded land mapping for Kalimantan and Papua Provinces

description.narrative: This activity Grant to World Resources Institute for creation of degraded land mapping for Kalimantan and Papua Provinces is a component of Degraded Land Mapping for Kalimantan and Papua provinces reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £2,250,269. It works in the following sector(s): Environmental policy and administrative management.
